### Orientation

| Dimension | Assessment |
|-----------|------------|
| **Empirical vs. Theoretical** | *(pending — no evidentiary basis collected; would require reading a sample of recent articles)* |
| **Quantitative vs. Qualitative** | *(pending)* |
| **Cross-disciplinary openness** | *(pending)* |

**Current positioning (what the journal accepts now):** 僅接受理論性貢獻(theoretical reviews、formal models、conceptual/理論分析),明確排除:純文獻綜述、方法/設計問題探討、單純實證發現報告。可接受「直接複製驗證(direct replications)」但須鑲嵌於新或強化的理論框架內。無字數上限,但超過15,000字需附正當理由說明(官方頁面數字;另一第三方轉述為25,000字,存在出入,以官方 apa.org 頁面為準)。2026年3月已刊出之近期文章例:'A Theory of Multiattribute Search and Choice'(Gluth, Deakin, & Rieskamp)為決策理論模型,與官方定位一致。未查得近期(2024-2026)特刊 CFP 之具體主題與截止日(calls-for-papers 頁面僅列出通用連結,無揭露內容)。

**Methods noted as welcome (qualitative — not a scored 0-5 table, see Methodological Preferences below):** 形式化/數理模型(formal/mathematical models), 理論整合與系統性理論比較評估(systematic evaluation of competing theories), 概念分析(conceptual analysis), 理論性直接複製驗證(direct replication embedded in theory-testing), Theoretical Notes(短篇理論評論/對既有理論的批評與討論)
